║                 GLACIER - Unified Pure C# .NET 10 LLM Stack                   ║
║   <15ms Cold Start | Zero Python/C++ | SIMD AVX-512 | PagedAttention | RAG    ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

Usage: glacier <command> [arguments] [options]

Core Execution Commands:
  run     <model.gguf> [prompt]        Execute streaming inference or interactive REPL
  tune    <base.gguf> --data <data>    Fine-tune model in minutes with in-process LoRA
  merge   <base> <adapter> <out>       Fuse LoRA delta adapter directly into base GGUF
  rag     --model <gguf> --docs <dir>  In-process SIMD Vector + CSR GraphRAG query
  serve   <model.gguf> [options]       Start drop-in Ollama/OpenAI PagedAttention server
  pull    <repo-or-url> [options]      High-speed chunked GGUF download with live progress
  agent   <prompt>                     Execute autonomous agent task with Glacier.Agent

Diagnostics & Benchmarks:
  devices                              Detect and audit GPUs, VRAM, and SIMD hardware
  inspect <model.gguf>                 Display GGUF architecture, metadata & tensors
  bench   <model.gguf> [options]       Measure cold start, prefill tok/s & decode tok/s
  config  [options]                    Manage persistent acceleration preferences

Run 'glacier <command> --help' or 'glacier help <command>' for command-specific options.
